notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.notes:
Ohayooh!

A new update for Setting Sun is ready to be played.

Thanks for trying out the demo, I hope you enjoy it and please let me know your thoughts in the comments or on Discord!

Also, if you like what you see, wishlist Setting Sun on my steam page!

Patch Notes
Gameplay:
- Town Update
The town has gotten a minor revamp.
The Dojo and the Blacksmith building have switched places and the Zen Garden has been moved a bit more to the center.
That has been done to make the town a little more compact and have players run around less.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40939141/55d1b6301b63d13f773558be2bb0629861fb22f9.png

Aside from that the gardener in Yatsushiro village did some work again and replanted all the flowers in town.

- Dungeon changes
A new type of room layout has been added

Art
- VFX updates
From playtesting I got some comments that there is a bit too much visual clutter at certain points in time.
So I made a couple of adjustements.

1) The rain is more transparent so that it obstructs less of the screen
2) The grass patches in the dungeon have been reduced in size and have been made more dense
3) When it's snowing the grass also becomes snowy

[previewyoutube=quGbxiYbtRA;full][/previewyoutube]

- Font update
The font in the game has been updated to make the in game text a little easier to read.
This was also a good opportunity to give the title screen font a graphical update.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40939141/756c4ba9160e219ad3c8a83013366f65e5d2b67c.jpg

Concept Art:
I didn't post it last update but I made an alternative concept art for the sorcerer with some magic effects and with his staff equipped.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40939141/f258bc0fdbd37b6c03e2445504b10decd63bd28d.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40939141/0f08da0b8ac0a6c7e64791a84ebd2e95c82026ac.jpg

Ronin:
- Ryu-jin the Fire Dragon's animation speed has been increased
- The ghost image that the ronin leaves behind after using certain moves now fades away correctly

Enemy Changes:
- Enemies now always show their healthbar
It's sometimes not very clear where all the enemies are located on screen.
This is a first step to make it more visible but some better solutions might come in the future.

- The Archer's run speed has been reduced to human levels of speed
- The Archer now has a more attack range

notes.title: Patch 1.0: Couch Co-op Fest
notes.notes:
Ohayooh!

A new update for Setting Sun is ready to be played during the couch co-op fest.

Thanks for trying out the demo, I hope you enjoy it and please let me know your thoughts in the comments or on Discord!

Also, if you like what you see, wishlist Setting Sun on my steam page!

Patch Notes
Gameplay:
- Added new NPC: Monk Ikkyu
The way gold is gathered has been reworked.
To accommodate some new features in the dungeon, the monk now acts as a broker.
Each time you discover a torii portal you can ask the monk to return your gathered gold to town to be put in the treasury (once per portal).
Money collected in the treasury is never lost until it is used.
Money gathered in the dungeon is lost upon death so make sure to return your gold back in time!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40939141/cfcaff48463320b11ff99409b2900288eca5b4a5.jpg

- Enemies have gotten a global cooldown between attacks

- Archer enemy model updated
 
- The camera has been zoomed out some more

- Spider webs have been updated
Instead of rooting, they slow you down and the visual has been updated

[previewyoutube=BanpFEHOC7s;full][/previewyoutube]

- Some new rooms can be discovered in the dungeon

- Most rooms have been reduced in size

- Room obstacles rotation and size is randomized

- The teleportation shrines have been updated with a better 3D model

Ronin:
- Dashing Strike rework
All basic attacks beside Dashing Strike add a Ki Charge to dashing strike.
At 4 charges the next Dashing Strike becomes an instant cast.
[previewyoutube=yoQqspnBdGY;full][/previewyoutube]

- New blessings have been added

- Tsukiyomi's Spirit pushes away surrounding enemies

[previewyoutube=pnfR8zIa2d0;full][/previewyoutube]

- Area slice cooldown between casts reduced slightly

- Dodge can now be cast without a target

- Bombs now drop slightly in front of the player

Art
- Town Grass updated
The gardener in Yatsushiro village did some fertilization and the grass has regrown more beautiful!

- A Character Preview object has been added in town
This new feature will be more useful in future updates, but you can show a full screen preview of your party.

[previewyoutube=ikyeMoOXhx0;full][/previewyoutube]

- Lightning strikes have been added during heavy rain

UI
- The title screen has gotten a graphical update
It now fits the game's name a bit better

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40939141/936b3e660870990f247045bd6c50b901fa9eb353.jpg

- The town map has gotten a much needed graphical update
Here's a preview of a colorized and tinted map

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40939141/b54796c7dbb18895390ec709c51f300f97e0fe85.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40939141/be750fd480bde952aacaa4f2f3f8442ad5edbf85.jpg

- The ingame cursor got a unique icon

- Several UI/menus have gotten a graphical update

- Player specific menus show the correct binding for the device they are using

notes.title: Patch 0.9: Dungeon V2
notes.notes:
Ohayooh!

A new update for Setting Sun is ready to be tested.

This update brings lots of dungeon changes, a new enemy, Ronin updates, UI changes and new artworks.

Thanks for trying out the demo, I hope you enjoy it and please let me know your thoughts in the comments or on Discord!

Also, if you like what you see, wishlist Setting Sun on my steam page!

Patch Notes
Dungeon Changes:
- A new spider enemy can now be encountered on your travels

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40939141/2ef8e42814c52bb1ee1e1605b4c867b671db2f7b.jpg

- Several obstacles in the dungeon are now destroyable through bombs/ultimate abilities

- Large scenery has been moved outside the rooms walls
All though it was a more “immersive” feeling to have all trees in your view, it was causing several issues. Enemies/interactables were obscured by the trees which could cause you to miss stuff or to not be able to react in time for ranged attacks.

On the other hand I didn’t want to remove the trees cause they fit the zone so good and work together well with the weather effects. So because the outside of the walls were just a empty void I decided to fill that space up with trees as the next best thing.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40939141/aedf2212eea0393dc70c7e0ed155955d42022b0c.jpg

- A couple of new room layouts have been added

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40939141/2676f830b36e3deb376b220cfc8c9299818bc1b6.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40939141/36527d14e4b745d9899d0b30bfcff675ef4cbdf2.jpg

- Rooms in the dungeon can now rotate
Another way to increase variation was to give all rooms to possibility to be rotated in 90 degree increments.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40939141/d7c0945e45d47a8e178c25cf6004b48ccaab6c96.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40939141/4b70c90a5295b8179ec158d879521f6ec2024e58.jpg

- The bamboo forest boss has been reworked
Hatamoto has gotten a new ability and his combat logic has been reworked.

- Added a miniboss room that can be encountered 

- Some rooms with an interactable have been decreased in size

Ronin changes:
- The ronin's yoko ryu combo attack has been replaced with a new area attack with unique blessings

- The player aiming system has been reworked
Now aiming in the direction of an enemy selects the enemy that the joystick points too the most within a angle of 60 degree from the player.

This allows you to be less accurate when aiming the stick and makes it easier to change targets that are very near to each other.

- Cost for blocking an attack reduced to 25 stamina

Gameplay changes:
- Forcing a game over during your dungeon now has a unique animation

- Some enemies have a global cooldown on their attacks

- Camera has been zoomed out slightly

Minor changes:
- Some new props have been added to the town

- Nights are less dark

- Big treasure chests can drop small treasure chests

- Added a blessing shrine in the zen garden in town to try out builds for PVP

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40939141/7adaf6d98f829dad220565e8d25a1a523e4c338f.jpg

- Daylight is less orange

- Rewards for clearing a room now spawn in the center of the room

Artwork:
- The Bamboo forest has a unique loading screen

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40939141/733bd020d416c8de3d66e6a45a0d3acbfda431c4.jpg

- New concept art for the sorcerer class

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40939141/2c29638967c5d7a9e7f016b42fa28b6ab23e4671.jpg


- New sake barrel 3D art

https://sketchfab.com/models/1f7f74adb8694f2a87726f35d591d3da

UI Changes:
- The blessing UI has been updated

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40939141/50cfd62ee3ccecaf30069642a2327d6e8e8e5da6.png

- Content in the pause menus show a background image

- Interact UI color changed to be more consistent with other labels

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40939141/de9fd60b369f4161435856c29b351ee3e486570c.png

notes.title: Patch 0.8: Seasons
notes.notes:
Ohayooh!

A new update for Setting Sun is ready to be tested.

This update brings weather effects, Ronin changes, dungeon changes, UI changes and new artworks.

Thanks for trying out the demo, I hope you enjoy it and please let me know your thoughts in the comments or on Discord!

Also if you like what you see wishlist Setting Sun on my steam page!

Patch Notes
Weather Effects:
- Several seasonal effects have been added to the game.
The weather changes at random intervals causing it to rain/snow/clear up.
The environment updates dynamically depending on the weather.

There's also some variation in rain differing from light drizzle to heavy storm.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40939141/88e6c4255357b130f099df31adabbecb0828675c.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40939141/78cf80c81d728ee6f3707a1badd7e55c0e50b1f9.jpg

- The day and night cycle have been updated with their own skybox for some more immersion.

Ronin Changes:
- The ronin's passive stance has been reworked.
After unlocking way of the ronin you can manually alter your damage done/taken balance.
This allows you choose for a more aggressive or defensive playstyle.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40939141/62aee303697909f48e42d9ca0bf9fdf69716f167.jpg

- The player doesn't take damage anymore during a hit reaction giving you a brief period of "Immunity".

- The blessing Aiki has been reworked.
Aiki now triggers an instant dashing strike on a perfect block.

- The new blessing "Blast Armor" has been added.
This blessing makes you immune to all damage coming from bombs.

Dungeon Changes:
- The mystery room has been reworked.
The previous version had 2 randomized chests (1 good, 1 bad) which seemed like a good idea on paper but in reality it wasn't really a choice causing you to just pick the nearest chest for convenience.

Now there is an option to either choose a gold chest or the mystery chest which can be anything even a gold chest!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40939141/769c1ca3bc13dc588b79105a93ec1a8dab4e4dc3.jpg

- The amount of enemies in a room has increased by 30% but enemy health has been reduced by 30%.
Some rooms only spawning 1 enemy made it seem kind of empty, so I'm trying to find a balance between more enemies and manageable combat.

UI Changes:
- The dojo interface has been updated.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40939141/ba130866150e17416872cdf1bdc562417a1d069c.jpg

- The player circle has been updated.
Now you always have an indication of your player's direction through the icon.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40939141/626c6e9a83d2492dccfb2ffbab5f0e894bfbceae.png

- The player frame has an updated Ronin Face
Aside from that the controller icons have also been changed

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40939141/06a93d3414ef3d69c505851777e73fb1f206f0e3.png

- The interaction UI for players has been moved to the player instead of the NPC.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40939141/0c61f23ea5b00cb19fecbe9038e1bde4bffa496b.jpg

Minor Changes:
The game has been updated from unity 2020 to unity 2021 LTS.
The controller icons have been updated.
Changing keybindings should now also update the icon in the player frame.
Lootable bombs don't drop anymore if no player has the bomb trinket.

notes.title: Patch 0.7: Going Rogue Fest
notes.notes:
Ohayooh!

A new update is now live for the Going Rogue: A festival of Persistence.
This update adds more enemies, features and bug fixes.

So check it out, let me know what you think or report bugs if you find any in the Discord.

Arigato!

Patch Notes

Dungeon:
A new wolf enemy joins the bamboo forest

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40939141/b7d627a90e5c44456886f58f008a5736eb1e0dfd.png

Ronin:
- The first version of trinkets have been added.
The dojo offers you 2 choices to buy: 
1) A Sushi plate, which restores health on demand
2) A bomb that you can drop for some extra damage to anyone in the vicinity

Each trinket has an amount of charges and extra charges can drop from enemies or chests in the dungeon.

- Each trinket also has some blessings tied to them discoverable at the dragon shrines.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40939141/343b0e5f02bc7bbc67363d4671993b44d7a10f7a.png

- Blocking when you don't have the required amount of stamina puts you in a block break state.

- Focussing an enemy has been expanded:
A setting has been added to auto focus an enemy when attacking.
You can stay focused on to an enemy with the focus button or attack manually in any direction you want. (if auto focus is disabled)
Aim assist allows you to change targets based on the direction you are aiming instead of changing targets manually with the right stick.

Town:
- The Torii gate in town has been upgraded to a small shrine

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40939141/6d7b0aa956f8e77297e17c15c385510e44c342a9.png

- The Dojo offers an extra row of abilities called trinkets
- The Dojo now only offers 1 passive in the first row for each class

UI:
- Added extra toggleable settings concerning enemy focussing
- Added a setting to toggle controller vibration
- A pop-up menu has been added to give notifications
- Parry has been renamed to block

Bugs:
- Multiplayer UI and controller fixes
